newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 25.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Talks underway on 1997 merger between United Saudi Commercial Bank and Saudi Cairo Bank.
- Yemen's privatisation law to be submitted to parliament next month.
- Jordan, Israel discuss ways to exchange goods.
- Saudi Arabia, Germany in talks on setting up joint projects worth 300 million riyals.
- Japan Import Export Bank pledges to provide $500 million for Qatar gas project.
- Suez Canal to offer 35 percent cut in transit dues for crude tankers.
